round_1: BLOCKED at the time - collection could not complete. Cause identified and fixed 2026-09-02; this run's corpus remains empty and is superseded by the next run.

sources.note: Working. Wrong population for the run subject though - HN will not contain cabinet shop owners, millwork estimators or job-shop machinists in any number.

RESOLVED 2026-09-02. The failure was never engine degradation. The container mounts searxng-settings.yml from the sibling 'Startup Ideation' repo, not from this one, so this repo's 2026-08-17 re-enable of google/duckduckgo never took effect. In the live file google, google cse, duckduckgo and startpage were all disabled: true. Enabling 'google cse' in the MOUNTED file fixed discovery outright: 44 records over 9 sequential calls, zero empties, no burst decay.
prior_misdiagnoses: First read: 'engines blocked, weak fallback answering'. Wrong - searxng healthy, bing answering.
Second read: 'site: operator ignored'. Tested the wrong call - the module deliberately omits site: and uses includeDomains (see comment in scripts/data/firecrawl.py:71).
Third read: 'short queries work, verbose fail'. Wrong - the same short query returned 2 rows then 0 a minute later. The variable is burst position, not phrasing.

Fourth read (2026-08-31, the one this file shipped): 'engine degradation on the current exit IP'. Wrong. Three engines were genuinely suspended, but the corpus failure was caused by four engines being disabled in a config file this repo was not editing. Cost: the run proceeded on an empty corpus.
sources.corrected_root_cause: Config-not-loaded, not rate-limiting. Edits were being made to an unmounted copy of searxng-settings.yml for at least two weeks.
sources.deleted_2026_09_02: Removed root_cause, history, fix_options and measured_2026_08_31 from this entry: each rested on the false claim that google and duckduckgo 'returned no results'. They returned nothing because they were disabled in the live config and never ran. Founder instruction 2026-09-02: delete the incorrect diagnosis rather than leave it standing. Verified-true observations are kept below.
